aiAskSubtitle: Questions about your chart, answered from its calculations
aiNoProfile: Create a profile with a birth date to ask questions about a chart.
aiRuleMode: Answers come from Drishti's built-in rules, which work offline on every phone. Download the on-phone AI model for conversational answers.
aiModelMode: Using the on-phone AI model. Every answer is checked against your calculated chart.
aiReplaced: The AI's draft did not pass Drishti's safety and accuracy check, so the rule-based answer is shown instead.
aiLoadFailed: The AI model could not be loaded on this phone, so rule-based answers are used.
aiSuggestCareer: How does my chart look for career?
aiSuggestPersonality: What does my chart say about my nature?
aiSuggestPeriod: What does my current dasha mean?
aiSuggestStudies: When is a good period for studies?
aiModelSubtitle: Download, use or remove the AI model
aiModelIntro: The AI model runs entirely on your phone. Nothing you ask is sent anywhere. Without it, Drishti still answers using its built-in rules.
aiMemorySubtitle: See or delete what Drishti remembers
aiLifeFactsInfo: Optional notes (e.g. "I work in teaching") that help answers. Stored only on this phone.
aiClearConfirm: This deletes the remembered questions and notes from this phone.
